subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Circuit Breakers and Fuses
description: One-minute skill: Circuit Breakers and Fuses.

hook.text: A short circuit can push thousands of amps through a wire. Breakers stop it fast.

buildup.text: A fuse has a thin wire that melts when current exceeds its rating. One-time use.

discovery.text: Circuit breakers trip magnetically and can be reset. No replacement needed.

twist.text: Grid-scale breakers must extinguish arcs at 500 kV — they use SF6 gas or vacuum chambers.

climax.text: Without protection, a single fault could cascade and destroy equipment across the grid.

punchline.text: Breakers sacrifice a circuit to save the system.

quiz.question: What advantage do circuit breakers have over fuses?
options: They can be reset after tripping without replacement
